name: samin-quick-ask
title: Quick Ask
description: Ask a fast model about what's on screen, or hand the task to a new T3 Code thread.
author: samin12

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Quick Ask
commands.subtitle: Haiku · sees your screen
commands.description: Type a question or a task. Enter answers right here, or opens a new T3 Code thread when it's real work. Command-Enter always answers here; Command-Shift-Enter always opens a T3 thread.

commands.name: new-thread
commands.title: New T3 Thread
commands.subtitle: T3 Code · default settings
commands.description: Start a new T3 Code thread with your message in the default project and model, then jump to it.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Fast Model
preferences.description: Model used for quick answers, through CLIProxyAPI.

preferences.name: useScreen
preferences.title: Screen
preferences.label: Let Quick Ask see the window behind the launcher
preferences.description: Takes a screenshot of the front window when you open Quick Ask. Needs Screen Recording permission for Nanolight.

preferences.name: projects
preferences.title: T3 Projects
preferences.description: Project folders for new T3 threads, separated by commas. The first one is the default.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: CLIProxyAPI Key
preferences.description: Leave empty to read CPA_API_KEY from ~/.cli-proxy-api/keys.env.
